# NoteCord

> NoteCord is an app for iPhone and iPad that records, transcribes and summarizes conversations while keeping recordings and text on your device.

## Key facts

- Platform: iPhone and iPad (iOS, iPadOS). Seller in the App Store: Danny Schuurman.
- Recording, transcription and summaries happen on the device. There is no NoteCord server and no account.
- App Store privacy label: Data Not Collected.
- Audio is excluded from every backup. Text is only included in the iPhone's own iCloud backup when that backup is on.
- Summaries with action points require Apple Intelligence.
- Made by Danny Schuurman, an independent maker in the Netherlands. Contact: danny@apexpartnerships.nl. Instagram: @notecordapp.
- Full text of every page: https://notecord.nl/llms-full.txt
